Weekly RSI at 50.2, weekly MACD histogram at -0.8763, indicating weakness. ADX at 20.5, in the early stages of trend formation. CCI at -159.4, extremely oversold. Stochastic %K at 16.7, %D at 13.0, in oversold territory. Fibonacci retracement at 79.4%. 4-hour RSI at 35.7, MACD histogram at -1.0690, showing weakness. Overall, insufficient evidence of buying pressure, hence a wait-and-see approach.
